articles.title: TikTok Owes $400 Million for Breaking Kids' Privacy Rules
articles.summary: TikTok got in big trouble for collecting kids' info without asking parents. Now it has to pay $400 million! The government says this is a big win for families. TikTok is also changing who owns part of it.

articles.title: Canada and U.S. Trade Fight: Tariffs Are Like a Tax on Stuff
articles.summary: Canada's leader says the U.S. is being unfair with new taxes on Canadian goods. So Canada will tax American stuff too, starting September 8. Both countries are upset, and talks broke down.

articles.title: A Ship Takes a Shortcut Through the Melting Arctic
articles.summary: South Korea sent a big container ship through the Arctic Ocean for the first time. It's a shorter route to Europe, but it's only possible because the ice is melting. Some people worry it could hurt the planet.
